title: Enforce one fail-closed local OperationID namespace across command families

surfaces.currentBehavior: Verified centralized local OperationID evidence inventory and ownership guard across all five current accepting stores; exact implementation commit and immutable CI are recorded in the evidence artifact.

surfaces: One ID-scoped fail-closed current-family evidence inventory used inside each accepting provider transaction
securityRequirements: Reserve malformed, orphaned, ambiguous, foreign-family, and multi-family evidence without disclosure, repair, or rebinding
syncRequirements: Inspect existing local/result/projection evidence, each exact ps_crud entry produced by an insert-only command view, and forbidden local result-table mutation queue evidence without adding synchronized or upload state

migration.rule: No shipped target database exists; untyped synthetic evidence is classified only when unambiguous and is otherwise conservatively reserved.
reconciliation: Every current operation-bearing relation, insert-only-view ps_crud command entry, forbidden result-mutation ps_crud type and accepting provider appears exactly once in the centralized inventory

acceptance: All current family pairs, orphan sources, concurrency, replay, restart, pinned-PowerSync insert-only representation, and static completeness obligations pass

surfaces.notes: No second registry table, server, upload, projection, cleanup, hosted, source-backend, migration execution, production, or cutover behavior.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Verified encrypted-local matrix covers current-family pairs, orphan/corrupt evidence, concurrency, lifecycle replay and drainage, injected failures, and restart; exact implementation commit and immutable CI are recorded in the evidence artifact.

surfaces: Deterministic encrypted local OperationID ownership integration suite
securityRequirements: Prove every present ownership evidence class reserves an ID without leaking cross-family or cross-scope details
syncRequirements: Prove refusal creates no new ps_crud, projection, pending, result, or receipt evidence

migration.rule: Use only disposable encrypted test databases and synthetic operation graphs.

acceptance: The frozen LOCALOPID test matrix passes without hosted resources

surfaces.notes: Passing local tests do not prove hosted authorization, real PowerSync synchronization, production migration, or cutover readiness.
